title: Harbor Cognitive Engine One
description: Llama 3.2 — multimodal language model family is the nominative anchor for this record. The Harbor Cognitive Engine One carries the same working details — adds vision understanding to the open model family — rendered as a fully original Signature work. It reached the market in 2024, aimed at developers.
